stewards.name: Tempo Labs
stewards.role: Co-author of the core (three of five authors); sole author of both intent drafts, the MCP transport draft and the three Tempo method drafts; co-author of the discovery draft (with Merit Systems) and the stripe method drafts (with Stripe); runs mpp.dev.

stewards.name: Stripe
stewards.role: Co-author of the core (two authors) and of the stripe methods; settles MPP payments in its platform.

stewards.name: Rail authors
stewards.role: Visa (card), Lightspark (lightning), Circle (usdc), Coinbase, MegaETH Labs and Monad Foundation (evm charge), OKG (evm session), Solana Foundation, Stellar Development Foundation, Hedera, Near One and Ripple maintain their methods.

implementers.name: Stripe (MPP acceptance with deposit addresses and SPTs)
implementers.role: Accepts MPP payments in stablecoins (USDC.e on Tempo, USDC on Solana) and in cards, Klarna and Affirm through SPTs, and runs streaming payments over MPP sessions on Tempo; stablecoin payments are open to businesses in every US state except New York; docs labeled Frontier.

implementers.name: Visa (mpp-card SDK)
implementers.role: Card method author and design partner for cards.

implementers.name: Lightspark
implementers.role: Lightning method author. mpp.dev names @buildonspark/lightning-mpp-sdk (0.1.4, 2026-03-18), whose npm maintainers include Lightspark addresses, as the lightning implementation; session support is listed as coming soon (2026-10-21).

implementers.name: Cloudflare Agents SDK
implementers.role: Documents MPP and uses mppx in guides.

implementers.name: Browserbase, PostalForm, Prospect Butcher Co., Stripe Climate, Parallel Web Systems
implementers.role: Named by Stripe at launch as MPP users.

implementers.name: Alchemy, Dune Analytics, Merit Systems
implementers.role: Named by Tempo in the launch directory.

implementers.name: Merit Systems (MPPscan)
implementers.role: Runs the MPP explorer and co-authored the discovery draft.

implementers.name: Tempo Wallet MACH
implementers.role: On-chain credit that an agent spends over MPP at approved merchants on Tempo, within limits the user approves: 1 USD buys 1 MACH through Coinflow, and MACH does not expire and cannot be sent to another personal wallet, redeemed for cash, swapped or bridged. On 2026-10-21, 19 directory listings carried the supportsMACH flag.

implementers.name: Tempo Wallet MPP Credits (legacy)
implementers.role: Card-funded credits for MPP services, announced 2026-06-17. On 2026-10-21 Tempo Wallet calls them legacy and keeps them separate from MACH; buying MACH does not convert them.

sdks.name: mppx
sdks.note: TypeScript SDK by wevm, MIT; server, client, CLI, proxy; serves x402 exact offers since 0.6.29 (2026-06-02) and has dual MPP and x402 framework wrappers since 0.9.0 (2026-08-27). Version 0.14.1 of 2026-10-21, latest as of that date.

sdks.name: pympp
sdks.note: Python SDK by tempoxyz. Version 0.14.0 of 2026-10-13, latest as of 2026-10-21.

sdks.name: mpp
sdks.note: Rust SDK (tempoxyz/mpp-rs). Version 0.16.0 of 2026-10-19, latest as of 2026-10-21.

sdks.name: github.com/tempoxyz/mpp-go
sdks.note: Go SDK. Version v0.2.0 of 2026-07-01, latest as of 2026-10-21.

sdks.name: mpp-rb
sdks.note: Ruby SDK in stripe/mpp-rb. Version 0.1.9 of 2026-10-19, latest as of 2026-10-21.

sdks.name: mpp-card
sdks.note: Visa card method SDK; proprietary license; no TAP signing code. Version as of 2026-10-21.

sdks.name: @buildonspark/lightning-mpp-sdk
sdks.note: Lightning method SDK that extends mppx, in the Spark organization's repository (MIT), with Lightspark addresses among its npm maintainers; mpp.dev lists session support as coming soon. Version 0.1.4 of 2026-03-18, latest as of 2026-10-21.

metrics.caveat: The indexer's own definition: MPPscan publishes no counting method and does not say whether test or wash payments are excluded, while Visa and Artemis exclude identified wash and test activity from their adjusted totals. A Merit Systems page dated 2026-06-24 shows the same live figures, so they are not June values.
About 0.10 USD per transaction on average.

metrics.metric: MPPscan unique senders and recipients, all time

metrics.caveat: About one cent (1.1 cents) per transaction on average.

metrics.definition: Rolling 7-day window shown by default on the homepage.
metrics.caveat: Do not read the homepage numbers as all-time totals.

metrics.definition: Listings in mpp.dev/api/services; 135 accept tempo, 10 stripe, 1 evm; 19 carry the supportsMACH flag.
Adjusted totals from the mid-March 2026 launch to 2026-04-21, excluding identified wash and test activity (Visa and Artemis, on Artemis on-chain data).
metrics.caveat: About 0.22 USD each. Visa's summary page was last updated 2026-07-14; Forkast (2026-07-20) repeats the figures.

metrics.definition: Stars on the two main repositories.

costs.value: None defined in any MPP spec; costs come from the rail
costs.caveat: Rail and processor fees still apply.

costs.value: Paid in USD TIP-20 stablecoins through the Fee AMM; the base fee for a 50,000-gas transfer is capped at about 0.0006 USD, with a quiet-period floor near 0.00003 USD, and optional priority fees come on top
costs.whoPays: Client by default; server when feePayer is true for charge, open and topUp; server always for settle and close
costs.caveat: Depends on Tempo base fee parameters; fees go to the proposing validator.

costs.value: Open on an existing reserve balance 72.1 percent less gas (294,425 versus 1,055,229); settle to a new payee balance 79.4 percent more (559,871)
costs.caveat: Up to 72 percent is the best case for one operation, not an average.

costs.value: Stripe pays customers' Tempo network fees
costs.caveat: Needs mppx 0.9.2 or later, live mode and a Tempo deposit address on the same account; not with Connect.

costs.value: 0.50 USD for SPT card payments; 0.01 USDC for stablecoin payments
1.5 percent of the transaction amount in USD, with conversion to fiat, wallet and AML screening, fraud prevention and gas sponsorship included (Stripe's US pricing page)
costs.caveat: Stripe's machine payments docs take MPP stablecoin payments through the Stablecoins and Crypto payment method, but no Stripe page names a rate for MPP or says whether this one applies to MPP charges. The 0.8 percent promotional stablecoin rate on the same page belongs to Link. The press reported the 1.5 percent in December 2025.

costs.value: 0.15 USD per SPT issued (Stripe's US pricing page)
costs.whoPays: Not stated; Stripe prices it per SPT issued, and the page's Learn more link opens the agent-side SPT docs
costs.caveat: Listed since at least 2026-04-23, the first archived copy that shows it. The page does not name the party billed or say how the price applies to SPTs used through MPP; the SPT docs, labeled Public preview, show no price.

costs.whoPays: No MPP-specific fee published; standard card acceptance costs (interchange, scheme and acquirer fees) are assumed to apply
costs.caveat: Evidence of absence: Visa's 2026-03-18 announcement and the card method spec name no price, and a secondary review of Visa Intelligent Commerce (Nevermined, 2026-08-19) reports no published agent-specific interchange or token fee. The atlas treats these payments as standard tokenized card-not-present economics until the networks publish otherwise. Stripe's SPT price belongs to the stripe method, not to this card method.
